storage.strategy: cloud-first; no full corpus on Mac

split.cross_official_split_overlap_action: exclude implicated training groups; preserve and report official test; never move test examples into training
split.source_groups_missing_action: record limitation; do not claim session independence

training.device: cloud single GPU only after approved environment/pilot; local M4 lightweight tests/CPU ONNX, no substantial local training
training.precision: float32 initially; mixed precision only after compatibility tests
training.selection: validation macro-F1, tie-break validation NLL; test never selects model
training.class_weight_policy: explicit inverse-frequency from training groups only
training.cpu_or_gpu_compatibility: probe Python 3.12, driver/VRAM and approved Torch build; do not overwrite provider runtime blindly
training.initial_data_scope: up to 2000 rights-cleared images; 5-12 classes only if independent-group support permits; final choice requires approval

evaluation.calibration: temperature scaling on dedicated calibration groups only
evaluation.intervals: group-bootstrap where groups/sample size permit; disclose small-class uncertainty
evaluation.ood_claim: none until independent development and untouched challenge data validate it
evaluation.review_required: always true; thresholds are research operating points, not clinical clearance

onnx_tolerance.status: proposed, must measure actual drift before artifact acceptance

api_proposal.mode: synchronous, ephemeral image bytes, no image/job/meal persistence
api_proposal.auth: existing principal/current study-patient grant/consent; deny-all default; test-only adapters remain tests
api_proposal.deadline_mechanism: terminate/restart dedicated inference process; not merely abandon a running thread
api_proposal.audit: protected operation/model/result metadata and correlation only; no image bytes/EXIF/raw paths
api_proposal.capabilities: single-label classification only after empirical evaluation; other output types explicitly unavailable
api_proposal.memory_mechanism: input/pixel caps plus sampled RSS watchdog; not a hard OS RSS reservation on macOS

dependency_gate: Base decoder/numerical/ONNX/CPU runtime installed and software-tested locally; Torch/Torchvision/onnxscript optional, not installed or GPU-qualified. Separate train-cpu source prevents accidental CPU-only cloud training.
